checks.ticket: Run npm run check on each serially integrated ticket. This starter conservatively checks all source/config files and all unit tests instead of guessing an incomplete changed-file subset. For UI, interaction, route or browser behavior changes, also run npm run test:e2e on that integrated commit before marking the ticket verified.
checks.full: Run npm run check:all on the final reviewed commit. This runs configuration/integrity checks, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, unit tests, build and Chromium E2E. Any code change after review invalidates affected review evidence; repeat applicable review and gates.
